hunks.newText:
\section{Introduction}
Traffic prediction is the focus of this paper; we begin by briefly describing its background and motivation. However, the research gap in this area has not yet been made explicit. To address this gap, our method uses a constrained encoder for traffic prediction. The main contributions are: (1) a calibrated benchmark; (2) a robust encoder; and (3) an open evaluation protocol. On the Metro test set, the proposed method reaches 91.2\% accuracy \cite{lee2021}.
